newsitem.title: USA: GM sees tax rate up in Q4 from Q3.
newsitem.headline: GM sees tax rate up in Q4 from Q3.

text.p: General Motors Corp expects its effective income tax rate to be about 27 percent in the fourth quarter, although that could vary depending on the outcome of labor talks and a strike at its Canadian operations, Chief Financial Officer Michael Losh said Tuesday.
"My best look is it ought to be comparable to the effective tax rate of the first nine months," Losh told reporters during a conference call.
A tax rate of 2.8 percent helped GM report strong third quarter earnings of $1.27 billion from continuing operations, compared to $396.7 million a year ago.
